operations.name: transform.apply
operations.description: Free-transform the active layer: scale about the center of its pixel content bounds (as reported by doc.get_state), rotate, and/or translate, then commit. One undoable step.

operations.name: transform.perspective_warp
operations.description: Perspective Warp the active raster layer. corners are destination quad corners in top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left order. Undoable.

corners.description: Destination quad as flat [x1,y1,...] or four {x,y} points

source_quad.description: Optional source quad; defaults to active layer content bounds

operations.name: transform.puppet_warp
operations.description: Puppet Warp the active raster layer with doc-space pins. Each pin is {x,y,target_x,target_y,rotate_deg?,rotation_locked?}. Commit is one undoable command.

pins.description: Pin objects with original x/y and optional target_x/target_y

rotation_locked.description: Ignore pin rotate_deg values when true (default true)
